title: Department of City Planning (DCP) report and proposed ordinance relative to a Code Amendment to Chapter I and Chapter 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code…
text:
[Council File 26-1247]
Department of City Planning (DCP) report and proposed ordinance relative to a Code Amendment to Chapter I and Chapter 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code to align with the Charter in the event that Ballot Measure “PL” is approved by the voters in the November 3, 2026 election. Ballot Measure “PL” proposes the establishment of a Neighborhood Appeals Commission that replaces Area Planning Commissions and establishes a process for City Council review of Neighborhood Appeals Commission and City Planning Commission decisions; changes the process for City Council action on certain planning decisions; and removes references to obsolete Charter Sections in the Zoning Code. The Amendments to the Los Angeles Municipal Code are exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to the California Public Resources Code Section 21080(b) (1) and CEQA Guidelines Sections 15320, 15378(b)(5), and 15061(b)(3); project findings.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
